obstetricare.title: ObstetriCare
obstetricare.subtitle: Early Warning System for preterm birth prevention
obstetricare.description: Full-stack system for preterm birth prevention with early alerts, clinical dashboards, and risk prediction based on ML model consensus.
obstetricare.problem: Preterm birth prevention and the need for early alerts in maternal-child health.
obstetricare.solution: Full-stack system with FastAPI backend and React/TypeScript frontend for clinical management, risk prediction, and AI-assisted recommendations.
obstetricare.pipeline: S-2: Random Forest + CatBoost + SVM consensus over 10 clinical variables → S-3: ordinal triage (GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED) → S-4: Gemini 2.0 Flash recommendations with IF-THEN fallback (SOGC 467).
roles: Administrator: users, analytics, and full access
Physician: smart record, prediction, triage, and model feedback
Secretary: operational dashboard, appointments, and patients (no ML modules)

architecture.summary: FastAPI API with role-based JWT authentication, PostgreSQL 16 with 14 Alembic migrations, and a 3-stage ML pipeline.

frontend.name: Frontend
frontend.description: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS with Recharts dashboards.

api.name: API
api.description: FastAPI with JWT authentication, roles, and async endpoints.

data.name: Data
data.description: PostgreSQL 16 with SQLAlchemy 2.0 async and Alembic.

ml.name: ML/AI
ml.description: 3-stage ML pipeline with weighted consensus and Gemini 2.0 Flash recommendations.

features: Risk prediction with weighted consensus over 10 clinical variables
Clinical recommendations with Gemini 2.0 Flash and rule-based fallback
technicalDecisions: SQLAlchemy async for non-blocking database operations
JWT with roles for access control
Deterministic AI fallback when the service is unavailable
Human-in-the-loop: physician feedback per model and clinical dictamen
results: Functional system deployed in academic/professional environment

amara.title: Amará
amara.subtitle: Emotional wellness web platform
amara.description: Full-stack emotional wellness platform with tracking, conversational assistant, and social integration.
amara.problem: Emotional wellness, tracking, and conversational support.
amara.context: Personal platform focused on emotional wellness and digital support.
amara.solution: Full-stack platform with Next.js, Supabase, and AI for emotional tracking, conversational assistant, and social features.
amara.pipeline: Emotional tracking with calendar and heat map → GPT-4o-mini conversational assistant with persistent history → social features with moderation.
roles: Authenticated user: emotional tracking, AI chat, and community
Serverless backend: Supabase Auth + RLS + protected API Routes

architecture.summary: App Router with Supabase Auth/Storage/RLS, versioned SQL migrations, authenticated API Routes, and AI assistant with dynamic context.

frontend.name: Frontend
frontend.description: Next.js 16 App Router with Tailwind CSS 4 and ES/EN i18n.

backend.name: Backend
backend.description: Authenticated API Routes and server-side logic in Next.js.

data.name: Data
data.description: Supabase with PostgreSQL, RLS, and versioned SQL migrations.

ai.name: AI
ai.description: Conversational assistant with OpenAI GPT-4o-mini and persistent history.

features: Emotional tracking with calendar, heat map, and statistics

Dynamic AI context with persistent history
